noMailSelectedDescription: Choose a message from the list to see its contents here.
noMailResultsDescription: Try a different search or filter.
settingsDescription: Shape OpenMail around the way you work. Changes are saved on this device.
minimizeToTrayDescription: Keep OpenMail running in the system tray when minimized.
closeToTrayDescription: Keep the app running when the window is closed.
confirmOnCloseDescription: Ask for confirmation before closing the application.
confirmActionsDescription: Ask for confirmation before destructive mail actions.
themeDescription: Choose the surface used across the application.
densityDescription: Control how much mail is visible in the list.
globalFontSizeDescription: Adjust text size across the entire application.
readerFontSizeDescription: Adjust the size of mail content.
sidebarWidthDescription: Set the width of the mail list sidebar.
readerWidthDescription: Set the maximum width of mail content.
languageDescription: Choose the language used by OpenMail.
notificationsEnabledDescription: Show a Windows notification when new mail arrives.
notificationSoundDescription: Play a sound with new mail notifications.
notificationSoundNameDescription: Choose the sound used for notifications.
quietHoursDescription: Mute desktop notifications during a scheduled period.
